extension_description.message: Copy and archive X (Twitter) posts, threads, and notes as Markdown for AI tools and local knowledge workflows.

launcher_title.message: X Markdown Exporter, drag to move

panel_subtitle.message: Save the current post or Note

mode_link_desc.message: Keep original image links for the smallest Markdown file.

mode_embed_desc.message: Compress and embed images in Markdown for a convenient single file.

mode_zip_desc.message: Bundle Markdown and images in a ZIP for complete offline archiving.

unsupported.message: Open an X post detail page or Note

not_ready.message: Waiting for the content to load. Refresh or reopen the detail page if this continues.

unsupported_timeline.message: Timelines cannot be exported directly yet. Open a post detail page first.

unsupported_explore.message: Explore pages cannot be exported directly yet. Open a post detail page or Note.

unsupported_search.message: Search pages cannot be exported directly yet. Open a post from the results.

unsupported_profile.message: Profiles cannot be exported directly yet. Open a post detail page or Note.

unsupported_other.message: This page cannot be exported yet. Open an X post detail page or Note.

metadata_note.message: Author and time are included by default.

download_warning.message: Download completed, but some resources could not be saved offline

no_active_tab.message: Could not access the active tab

retry_after_refresh.message: The page is not ready. Refresh and try again.

retry_tweet.message: Open a post detail page and try again

retry_note.message: Open a Note page and try again

retry_page.message: Refresh the page and try again

extraction_empty.message: Content extraction returned empty, possibly because X changed its page structure.

issue_if_persistent.message: If the problem continues, open a GitHub issue:

main_tweet_not_found.message: The current post body was not found. Make sure a post detail page is open and fully loaded. Refresh and try again if the problem continues, or open a GitHub issue:

warning_embed_hard_switch.message: Embedded data exceeded 40 MB, so the export was switched to ZIP.

embed_confirm_after.message:

Select OK to export one file, or Cancel to switch to ZIP.
